avd_design_evaluation.active_outcome: Cleartext encryption iterates null host and fails. Pre-encrypted key bypasses encryption but preserves a non-null key in output; Radius TLS enabled preserves TLS settings. Consequently a retained server loses required/primary-key host after stripping and fails EOS validation. Tacacs also preserves resolved VRF. Missing both usable key forms already raises. No server-selection filter provides a null-specific success path.
avd_design_evaluation.migration: Supply host or remove server. Later structured-config override repair is a separate global possibility, not established here.
avd_design_evaluation.evidence_basis: Static consumer, selection and output-schema analysis; saved observations remain separately identified. No customer prevalence or device acceptance claim.

output_validation_context.scope: Synthetic final EOS models, stripping, optional override merge and public validation; not full design generation.

enforcement_policy.scope: 166 required non-primary declarations outside all structured-config overrides.
enforcement_policy.proposal: Reject explicit null on required fields during ordinary AVD Design input validation; do not infer broader reject-null policy for optional fields or scalar list items.
enforcement_policy.collection_scope: Assess both scalar-only rejection and all-required rejection; collection null tombstones are a separate compatibility concern.
enforcement_policy.verdict_semantics: active-path-already-rejected means no successful null case established in inspected regular active paths; it is not a universal compatibility guarantee (custom overrides can repair output). behavior-changing-rejection identifies schema-permitted null suppression/fallback/omission/formatting paths; mixed-rejection combines such permitted/dormant contexts with failing active ones. Static accepted contexts are constructible code/schema scenarios, not measured customer prevalence or demonstrated full builds.
enforcement_policy.assessment_semantics: reviewed means static consumer-family and ordinary-occurrence routing reviewed. It does not certify every combination of surrounding inputs, full-fabric builds, external APIs or EOS device acceptance. No pending declarations remain; runtime observations stay separately tagged.
enforcement_policy.prior_observation_semantics: prior_confirmed_observations preserve previously reported comparisons without presenting them as new probes; raw saved method cases are separately linked. Static findings identify permitted code/schema scenarios, not complete successful builds.
